CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, November 19, 2025 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Justin Love, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE OCTOBER 15, 2025 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  TAM STUDIO: 726 EAST MAIN STREET PUBLIC ART PROPOSAL

  V.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

 VI.  STAFF REPORT

VII.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VIII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until approved by the  November 19, 2025
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, October 15, 2025
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:03 P.M. on Wednesday, October 15, 2025 in Conference Room “A” at Alhambra City Hall,
111 South First Street Alhambra, 91801.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: Vice President Saunders, Commission Member Hermano,
Commission Member Love and Commission Member Navarro.
Commission Members Absent: President Canseco.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Boettcher,
and Clerical Assistant II Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE SEPTEMBER 17, 2025 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
MINUTES
With a motion from Commission Member Hermano and a second from Commission Member
Navarro, the September 17, 2025 minutes were approved as written.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
Commission Member Hermano shared a rendering for her proposed district 3 historical mural
and Vice President Saunders recommended to include more Alhambra buildings or landmarks
before finalizing. Director Macias encouraged Commission Member Hermano to set aside the
rendering until more timeline details emerge for the Alhambra Historical Society Museum
construction; estimated timeline is currently set at 18 months from March 2026.

STAFF REPORT
The Alhambra City Art and Cultural Events Commission approved Valerie Daval, Angel Barris,
Lisa Hirata, and Franshesca Oliveras to exhibit in the Alhambra City Hall Lobby Art Gallery.

Recreation Supervisor Boettcher invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission and their families to attend the upcoming Alhambra Pumpkin Run on Sunday
October 26, 2025 and Veterans Day Commemoration on Tuesday November 11, 2025.
Recreation Supervisor Boettcher shared that the Holiday Home Decorating applications and
Rose Parade Float Decorating Volunteer list will be available to the public next month.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
No committee communication exchanged.
 ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Hermano and a second by Commission Member Navarro,
the October 15, 2025 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:20
P.M.
